cli.intro: OpenExcel — read, inspect and export spreadsheet workbooks on one declared model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.open: Open a project file and print its sheets and cells
cmd.summary: Print the current sheets, revisions and cell counts of a project file
cmd.save: Write an open project back to a project file
cmd.edit: Set one cell of a project file and optionally save the result, or pass --ops with a JSON array of SDK edit operations
cmd.sort: Sort the rows of a range by one column and optionally save the result
cmd.format: Apply cell styles to a range and optionally save the result
cmd.layout: Set column widths or row heights and optionally save the result
cmd.row: Insert or delete whole rows and optionally save the result
cmd.column: Insert or delete whole columns and optionally save the result
cmd.sheet: Add, rename, remove, duplicate or move a sheet and optionally save the result
cmd.inspect: Run formula, reference and range checks on a project file
cmd.cell: Read one cell of a project file with its evaluated value
cmd.range: Read a rectangle of cells with their evaluated values
cmd.recalc: Recompute every formula of a project file
cmd.find: Search evaluated values and formulas of a project file
cmd.export: Export a project file to a spreadsheet format

opt.title: Workbook title
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: formulas, references, cycles, types, ranges, styles
opt.format: Export format: xlsx, xlsm, csv, tsv, json, html or pdf
opt.cell: A1 cell reference such as B4
opt.value: Text, number, boolean or null to store in the cell
opt.formula: Formula to store in the cell, with or without the leading `=`
opt.ops: JSON array of edit operations; replaces the single-cell options
opt.column: Sort column: a one-based offset inside the range or a column letter
opt.header: Keep the first row of the range in place
opt.number-format: Number format code applied to the range
opt.align: Horizontal alignment: left, center, right, justify, distribute or fill
opt.wrap: Wrap long text inside the cell
opt.layout-column: Column to size: a one-based number or a column letter
opt.width: Column width in Excel character units
opt.hide: Hide the given column or row
opt.insert-row: One-based row the new rows appear before
opt.insert-column: Column the new columns appear before: a one-based number or a letter
opt.delete-column: First column to delete: a one-based number or a letter
opt.count: Number of rows or columns to insert or delete, default 1
opt.index: Zero-based position the sheet moves to
